# Project: lilygo-claude

All Faculty coding standards are served by the Faculty MCP server. There are no standards files in this repo — call `faculty_list_standards` at session start and `faculty_get_standard <path>` before writing code.

## Workflow

Load the full workflow with `faculty_get_standard org/workflow` at session start. Steps are gated mechanically — call `faculty_gate_list` from the MCP server to see what's enforced. Do not skip ahead to writing code.

> Deep-reasoning mode: **ultrathink**. Steps marked with **use ultrathink** in the workflow standard benefit from deep reasoning — do that before producing output. Change via `faculty_deep_reasoning_mode` in `.faculty/gates.json` (`ultrathink` | `plan` | `both`); re-run `faculty init` or `faculty migrate to-mcp-sot` to propagate.

Agent role definitions come from the MCP server: `faculty_list_agent_roles` / `faculty_get_agent_role <role>`. The `.claude/agents/` files on disk are regenerated from MCP at init/upgrade time — do not edit them in place.

## Active gates

Faculty generates Claude Code hooks in `.claude/settings.json` and Codex hooks in `.codex/hooks.json`.
Run `faculty doctor` to check configuration. Review and trust Codex hooks through `/hooks` before relying on them.
Call `faculty_gate_list` from the MCP server to see the checks. A gate deny includes the exact remediation; follow it.

## Gotchas

- **Service renames must be paired.** If you rename `services/<name>/`, also rename both `docs/architecture/<name>.md` and `docs/architecture/<name>-threats.md` to match. Gates pair service-dir-name 1:1 with spec-file-name; a mismatch will deny all subsequent writes into the renamed service.

## Project-specific overrides

See `.claude/overrides/project.md` for rules specific to this project that extend or deviate from the org standards served by MCP.
